content.title: BOCA by Chef Maria Mazon | Tucson Tacos and Mexican Cuisine
content.text: Fresh, Original Mexican Tacos, Salsa y Tequila Outpost for modern Mexican fare, imaginative salsas and local craft beers with a dog-friendly patio in the heart of Tucson. Come for lunch, dinner, or happy hour and then walk up Historic Fourth Avenue, take the streetcar downtown, or bike over to the University of Arizona. As featured on Top Chef, Food Network, New York Times, and Travel Channel; Tucson City of Gastronomy Certified; James Beard Award Semifinalist. DINE IN or TAKEOUT 533 N 4th Ave Tucson, AZ 85705 OPEN HOURS Monday–Thursday: 12pm – 9pmFriday–Saturday: 12pm – 10pmSunday: 12pm – 8pm Menu FROM OUR KITCHEN TO YOUR BOCA We do serve tacos. But we serve gourmet food on a taco. Specialties Gourmet Tacos All of our food is made fresh to order. In each of our varieties of tacos, we innovate and elevate the Mexican cuisine, bringing a taste of Sonora to Tucson.Full Bar & Patio Local, craft tacos means local, craft beer, including over very own La Sonorita in collaboration with Borderlands Brewing. But that’s not all. We have over 40 tequilas, vodkas, scotches and whiskies to enjoy at the bar or out on our dog-friendly patio. Original Salsas We don’t follow the rules when it comes to the salsa department. Created fresh daily, each new flavor is an eclectic pallet of colors and original ingredients.Fresh Chips What goes better with salsa than warm, crispy chips?
